evals.name: web-loop-start-branch-contract-then-indefinite-cycle
evals.prompt: 웹 루프 시작해줘. 우리 대시보드 UI 계속 개선해줘, 멈추지 말고.
evals.expected_output: branch contract ASK FIRST 후 loop 진입. 각 cycle: TOOL RUNNER(sonnet) → EVALUATOR(opus) → 최우선 이슈 pick → P0 fast-path or P1/P2 plan gate → commit → harness-flow-progress.md append → 반복. Playwright MCP 없어도 degraded mode 로 계속.

assertions.text: Response runs kzk-autonomous-boundary ASK-FIRST branch contract before any commit — proposing feature/web-loop-<goal-slug> as default but waiting for user OK per §Entry step 2

Response dispatches TOOL RUNNER (oh-my-claudecode:executor, model=sonnet) then EVALUATOR (oh-my-claudecode:critic, model omitted → opus inheritance) as separate fresh subagents per §Loop Structure steps 1a/1b
Response specifies EVALUATOR outputs a P0/P1/P2 prioritized issue list per §Evaluation Criteria (P0=console errors/test failures/build errors, P1=accessibility/responsive, P2=complexity/duplication)
Response specifies that Playwright MCP drop triggers cascade recovery then degraded mode — the loop never halts on Playwright failure per §Playwright Resilience
Response specifies appending to harness-flow-progress.md after every cycle in canonical format: 'Cycle N (YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM) — [P-level] [issue] — queue: N remaining — PW: ok|degraded'
